portal_synopsis: Important: Red Hat Integration Debezium 1.1.3 security update
portal_solution:
To apply this update just follow standard installation procedure

https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_integration/2020-q2/html/installing_debezium_on_openshift/installing_debezium_connectors
allTitle: (RHSA-2020:3005) Important: Red Hat Integration Debezium 1.1.3 security update
title: (RHSA-2020:3005) Important: Red Hat Integration Debezium 1.1.3 security update
portal_summary:
An update for Debezium PostgreSQL connector is now available for Red Hat Integration.

Red Hat Product Security has rated this update as having a security impact of Important. A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE link(s) in the References section.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Integration|Red Hat Integration|Text-Only Advisories|x86_64
portal_description:
PostgreSQL is an advanced object-relational database management system. The Debezium PostgreSQL connector includes JDBC driver to access a PostgreSQL database.

Security Fix(es):

* postgresql-jdbc: XML external entity (XXE) vulnerability in PgSQLXML (CVE-2020-13692)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS
score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
